name: coptic-reference
description: Static, offline-capable reference for the Coptic language. No runtime dependencies on the reading path.

comments.acorn: PINNED EXACTLY, no caret. Session 22 D0: no_object_object_guard parses every published JS file with acorn and walks the AST. The guard's verdict must not float with a parser upgrade that changes node shapes.
comments.pagefind: PINNED EXACTLY, no caret. v4 §2.2: Pagefind runs in ONE pass via createIndex/addDirectory/addCustomRecord/writeFiles. Its output must be byte-reproducible across bakes, which a floating version would break.
comments.hugo-bin: Pinned so local and Cloudflare Pages builds agree. Cloudflare does NOT install Hugo; the build command fetches the extended .deb at the pinned version (v4 §5.3).
comments.no-deps: There are no runtime dependencies. Everything served to a reader is static HTML/CSS/JS/JSON. The Worker in workers/suggest/ is the only runtime component in the project and has zero dependencies.
